about.heading: Hi, I'm Elsa.
paragraphs: Hi, I'm Elsa — a Bali-based virtual assistant with over 8 years of experience helping entrepreneurs and villa owners get their time back.

I specialise in the small tasks that quietly steal hours from your day — answering guest messages, managing inboxes, following up on bookings, coordinating schedules, handling the admin. Not the big strategy work — the operational detail that needs to get done so you can stay focused on growing.
What sets me apart is simple: I'm reliable, fast, and I understand Bali business. You hand me a task, it gets done — so your attention stays where it belongs.
credibility: 8+ years across admin, customer service & property management in Bali
Fluent English communicator — experienced with international guests and global clients daily
Currently helping clients reclaim hours every week — with zero missed tasks
Based in Bali — I understand your market, your guests, and your time zone

steps.title: We have a quick chat
steps.body: Send me a WhatsApp or email. Tell me which tasks are eating your week — I'll get back to you as soon as possible.

steps.title: You walk me through your world
steps.body: You share your systems, give me the access I need, and explain how you like things done. Your workflow stays exactly as it is — I slot in and follow your lead. The clearer your brief, the faster I can start delivering.

steps.title: We start — this week
steps.body: No lengthy onboarding. Once you've shared what I need, I get to work. Most clients notice the difference within the first few days.

pricing.heading: Simple, flexible pricing
pricing.note: Available hours: 10am – 5pm, Monday to Friday (Bali time, WIB). You decide what the hours are used for (24-hour notice for new tasks). Task summary included so you always know what was done. Choose a package and use it across your tasks within 30 days from purchase date.

specialist.title: Virtual Villa Management
longTerm: Sourcing and screening suitable long-term renters for homeowners
Managing all online communication with tenants throughout their stay
Coordinating lease inquiries, check-in details, and ongoing requests digitally
Acting as the point of contact so the owner doesn't have to be
shortTerm: Managing all Airbnb guest messaging — inquiries, confirmations, and check-ins
Booking coordination and calendar management across platforms

specialist.model: This service runs on a 10–15% commission agreed per property — separate from the VA retainer packages above. Low-risk for the client, results-aligned for you.

items.a: Usually within the same week. Once we've had a short call and you're happy with the proposal, I can typically start in 2–3 business days.

items.q: Do I need to sign a long-term contract?
items.a: No. I work on monthly retainers with no lock-in. Most clients stay because the results speak for themselves — not because they have to.
However works best for you — WhatsApp, email, or a shared tool like Trello or Notion. I adapt to your workflow, not the other way around.

items.q: What if I need to pause or cancel?
items.a: Just give me two weeks' notice. No awkward conversations, no penalties. Life changes — I understand that.
Absolutely. I treat client information with complete confidentiality and am happy to sign an NDA if required.

items.q: What time zone do you work in?
items.a: I'm based in Bali (WIB, UTC+8) and typically available 9am–6pm. For time-sensitive villa or guest comms, I'm flexible with hours.

items.q: Can you handle things in Indonesian?
items.a: Yes. I'm a native Indonesian speaker and can communicate with local vendors, staff, and suppliers on your behalf.
